traceability.evidence:
Implementation and tests for this story clearly exist, but I could not obtain a passing test run for the rule.
Key implementation artifacts: - Core rule: - src/rules/valid-annotation-format.ts - Validates @story and @req (and @implements) annotation values via: - validateStoryAnnotation(context, comment, rawValue, options) - Enforces path pattern from options.storyPattern (default /^docs\/stories\/[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-DEV-[\w-]+\.story\.md$/) - Handles missing values, invalid formats, and auto-fixable suffix issues (".md", ".story.md") - Uses buildStoryErrorMessage to produce specific error details - JSDoc ties to this story: @story docs/stories/005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md with @req REQ-PATH-FORMAT, REQ-ERROR-SPECIFICITY, REQ-SYNTAX-VALIDATION - validateReqAnnotation(context, comment, rawValue, options) - Enforces identifier pattern from options.reqPattern (default /^REQ-[A-Z0-9-]+$/) - Handles missing identifiers and invalid formats - Uses buildReqErrorMessage for detailed, specific error text - JSDoc: @req REQ-REQ-FORMAT, REQ-ERROR-SPECIFICITY - processComment / processCommentLine - Scans all comments from sourceCode.getAllComments() - Detects @story and @req and accumulates multi-line values into PendingAnnotation - Supports @implements as single-line; validates separately - Explicit JSDoc references: - REQ-MULTILINE-SUPPORT (multi-line handling) - REQ-FLEXIBLE-PARSING (whitespace/format variation) - REQ-SYNTAX-VALIDATION (dispatch by tag type) - finalizePendingAnnotation - Dispatches to validateStoryAnnotation / validateReqAnnotation based on pending.type - JSDoc: REQ-SYNTAX-VALIDATION - Rule meta: - meta.docs.description: "Validate format and syntax of @story, @req, and @implements annotations" - messages.invalidStoryFormat / invalidReqFormat use shared pattern "Invalid annotation format: {{details}}." (specific details provided by helper functions) - schema: getRuleSchema() from valid-annotation-options (JSON Schema options support) - fixable: "code" with clear constraints on safe suffix normalization.
- Helper modules dedicated to this story: - src/rules/helpers/valid-annotation-format-internal.ts - normalizeCommentLine and PendingAnnotation type - JSDoc references this story and REQ-MULTILINE-SUPPORT, REQ-FLEXIBLE-PARSING - src/rules/helpers/valid-annotation-utils.ts - collapseAnnotationValue(value: string): collapses whitespace for multi-line values - Used to support REQ-MULTILINE-SUPPORT and REQ-FLEXIBLE-PARSING - getFixedStoryPath(original: string): safe suffix normalization for @story paths - Rejects paths with ".." (no traversal auto-fix) - Handles .story, .md, and no-extension paths conservatively - buildStoryErrorMessage / buildReqErrorMessage: construct clear, specific error texts, echoing offending value and including examples, satisfying REQ-ERROR-SPECIFICITY. - Constants STORY_EXAMPLE_PATH and default examples align with story examples (e.g. "docs/stories/005.0-DEV-EXAMPLE.story.md"). - src/rules/helpers/valid-annotation-options.ts - Default patterns and examples: - storyPattern default: /^docs\/stories\/[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-DEV-[\w-]+\.story\.md$/ (REQ-PATH-FORMAT) - reqPattern default: /^REQ-[A-Z0-9-]+$/ (REQ-REQ-FORMAT) - resolveOptions / getRuleSchema implement configurable patterns and examples (support later stories but still used here).
- Rule wiring and integration: - src/index.ts - RULE_NAMES includes "valid-annotation-format" so it is dynamically loaded. - TRACEABILITY_RULE_SEVERITIES includes "traceability/valid-annotation-format": "warn". - configs.recommended and configs.strict include that mapping, so this rule runs alongside function (require-story-annotation, require-req-annotation) and branch rules.
- Tests explicitly tied to this story: - tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts - File header: /** * Tests for: docs/stories/005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md * @story docs/stories/005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md * @req REQ-FORMAT-SPECIFICATION - Verify valid-annotation-format rule enforces annotation format syntax * ... additional @story/@req for related stories ... */ - describe block: "Valid Annotation Format Rule (Story 005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION)" - Valid cases directly covering requirements: - [REQ-PATH-FORMAT] valid story annotation format (single-line) - [REQ-REQ-FORMAT] valid req annotation format (single-line) - [REQ-FORMAT-SPECIFICATION] valid block annotations - [REQ-MULTILINE-SUPPORT] valid multi-line @story and @req values - [REQ-FLEXIBLE-PARSING] JSDoc-style comments with varying whitespace - Invalid cases matching the story’s invalid examples: - Missing story path: `// @story` → invalidStoryFormat with "Missing story path..." - Invalid story extension: `.story` fixed to `.story.md` with matching error text - Missing extension: no suffix → auto-fix to `.story.md` - Path traversal: `../docs/stories/...` rejected with clear error message - Missing/invalid @req IDs: `// @req`, `// @req invalid-format`, and multi-line invalids - Additional tests exercise configuration error handling and ensure error messages include correct, specific details, satisfying REQ-ERROR-SPECIFICITY and related error-reporting requirements.
Test execution evidence: - I attempted to run only this test file with Jest: - Command: - npm test -- --runInBand --verbose --testPathPattern tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts - Output: > eslint-plugin-traceability@1.0.5 test > jest --ci --bail --runInBand --verbose --testPathPattern tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts - The command returned exit code 1, and no Jest summary or test results were printed before the tool timeout. - A previous generic test run also showed only the Jest invocation line and no results, suggesting Jest is currently failing or not completing successfully in this environment.
Documentation: - The story file docs/stories/005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md itself includes detailed valid/invalid annotation examples matching behavior enforced by valid-annotation-format.ts and verified in tests. - Helper code embeds default example paths and requirement IDs used consistently in error messages, aligning with the spec’s examples.
traceability.notes:
The annotation format validation functionality for @story and @req is clearly implemented and extensively tested in src/rules/valid-annotation-format.ts and its helper modules, with tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts that directly reference this story and all of its listed requirements (REQ-FORMAT-SPECIFICATION, REQ-SYNTAX-VALIDATION, REQ-PATH-FORMAT, REQ-REQ-FORMAT, REQ-MULTILINE-SUPPORT, REQ-FLEXIBLE-PARSING, REQ-ERROR-SPECIFICITY). The rule integrates into the plugin via src/index.ts and uses standard ESLint practices (meta, schema, messages, RuleTester tests), and the implementation matches the valid/invalid examples given in the story.
However, when running the Jest test suite for this story’s test file, the command `npm test -- --runInBand --verbose --testPathPattern tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts` exited with code 1 and produced no test summary. This indicates that tests are not currently passing (or not successfully executing) in this environment. Since the story’s Definition of Done and acceptance criteria require that tests are written and passing, and the test run does not succeed, the story cannot be marked as fully PASSED based on concrete evidence. Functionally and structurally the implementation appears complete, but the failing test execution means at least one acceptance condition is not met, so the status is FAILED.
